C_inputs_are_the_committed_ones.can_fail_because: any set is missing from S77/measure.json or any sibling/depth value is absent or non-numeric
C_inputs_are_the_committed_ones.must_fire_because: this spike computes rather than measures, so its inputs must be the reviewed spikes' committed numbers and not retyped prose -- retyping a number out of a page is D6 hole H5 performed on purpose
C_inputs_are_the_committed_ones.name: C_inputs_are_the_committed_ones
C_inputs_are_the_committed_ones.null_must_contain: S77's measure.json, whose values this spike reads and cannot adjust

C_inversion_survives_minimal_framing.can_fail_because: the flip threshold is at or below 2 B per physical node
C_inversion_survives_minimal_framing.must_fire_because: S77's inversion is the retraction; if a 1-2 B segment length per physical node undoes it, the retraction is specific to the logical view and must say so
C_inversion_survives_minimal_framing.name: C_inversion_survives_minimal_framing
C_inversion_survives_minimal_framing.null_must_contain: the atom trie's 139.1 physical nodes per path against the triples' 10.3 -- a 13x gap with ample room to overturn a 785 B sibling gap

C_single_child_physical_node_carries_no_.can_fail_because: the composition comment is absent, or the loop does not hash a (path, child_hash) pair per child, i.e. the node hash is not built from its children's digests one at a time
C_single_child_physical_node_carries_no_.must_fire_because: the whole question is whether a physical commitment charges per NODE or per SIBLING; the source states the composition and the loop implements it, so this is decidable without a measurement
C_single_child_physical_node_carries_no_.name: C_single_child_physical_node_carries_no_digest
C_single_child_physical_node_carries_no_.null_must_contain: merkleization.rs, which is equally free to hash a fixed child array, a 256-slot map, or every node on the path -- any of which would charge a digest per node and flip this

C_threshold_is_decision_relevant.can_fail_because: the flip threshold falls outside 1.0-32.0 B per node
C_threshold_is_decision_relevant.must_fire_because: a threshold outside any framing anyone would build answers nothing in either direction, and publishing it would be a number with no decision attached
C_threshold_is_decision_relevant.name: C_threshold_is_decision_relevant
C_threshold_is_decision_relevant.null_must_contain: a computed F free to land anywhere: below 1 B (even a length field flips the ordering, so S77 needs qualifying) or above 32 B (a full digest per node would not flip it, so the caveat was never a risk)

grade: D (arithmetic over measured inputs) with one E input (composition read from source, not measured)
minimal_framing_is: a segment length, 1-2 B; the segment BYTES are key bytes the verifier already holds and the child hash is the value it computed from below
verdict: the ordering flips only if a physical-node commitment costs more than 6.1 B of framing per node on the path; minimal framing is a segment length at 1-2 B, so S77 survives with a 3.0x margin
